newsitem.title: UK: Northwest Europe oil output falls in May - WoodMac.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Europe oil output falls in May - WoodMac.

text.p: Northwest European oil production fell 385,000 barrels per day (bpd) in May to 5.9 million bpd, industry consultants Wood Mackenzie said on Tuesday.
Britain bore the brunt of the losses, with total offshore and onshore production falling by nine percent or 231,000 bpd to 2.3 million bpd.
North Sea production excluding Britain fell by 154,000 bpd in May to 3.6 million bpd, from record levels posted in April.
Norwegian production fell by five percent or 162,000 bpd to 3.3 million bpd, hit by scheduled and unscheduled field maintenance.
Dutch output fell 5,000 bpd to a new low of 30,000 bpd.
Denmark was the only producer to increase output in May, pumping an additional 13,000 bpd to take total production to a record level of 236,000 bpd.
All figures include natural gas liquids (NGLs).
